title: Regression: Not Tracked and the part window price fields read correctly in dark mode and at 1024 px
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com, S2 shop. Location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. QAPL-U1 (untracked, no bins) and QAPL-U2 (untracked, 2 bins) exist. Theme set to Dark (profile > Dark); window 1024 px wide. Restore theme and size after the test.
custom_steps:
1. Open /parts/inventory (Active tab) and search QAPL-U.
  2. ⋮ > Cycle count and look at the QAPL-U1 and QAPL-U2 rows; then Cancel.
  3. Click New Inventory Part (button_new_inventory_part).
  4. Pick a Category, then type values in Cost, Sell Price and Core Charge.
  5. Look at the Inventory Tracking section and switch tracking off and on.
custom_expected:
1. Total Qty (text_not_tracked_{id}) reads Not Tracked in a muted grey that is still legible on the dark background, with no chip; QAPL-U2's bin chips read correctly.
  2. The count cell (text_count_not_tracked_{id}) reads Not Tracked, muted but readable, with no count inputs.
  3. The dialog (dialog_inventory_part) is dark-themed and readable.
  4. Cost, Sell Price and Core Charge lay out without overlapping or cut-off labels; the typed values are readable.
  5. The Inventory Tracking heading, info icon, switch and Min/Max read correctly; Min and Max hide and come back without the layout breaking.
